name: Gieo Text
classification_notes: Drawing on late 15th to 16th century Venetian humanist models with calligraphic, asymmetrical serifs and a right-leaning stem, Gieo Text sits in the old-style serif category built for extended reading.
summary: A humanist text serif with calligraphic, asymmetrical serifs and a quiet, unobtrusive character built for long-form reading.
description: Gieo Text draws on Venetian humanist models from the late 15th and 16th centuries, pairing gentle curves with sharp asymmetrical serifs and a right-leaning stem. Six weights from Regular to Black each carry a matching italic, and the design covers an extensive Latin character set including Vietnamese. It is built to stay out of the way of the reader rather than announce itself.
foundry_blurb: ÁccentiaType describe Gieo as meaning 'to sow a seed' in Vietnamese, a type family for immersive reading on screens and in print. They say its letters carry prominent calligraphic features that echo the rhythmic gesture of a confident writing hand, designed to be subtle and unobtrusive so the reading experience stays undisturbed.
